diagnose.note: diagnose() on i2c:0 at 0x69: the verdict, up to ' -- ' (the error's repr is the runtime's own)

probe.note: probe(): the transcript and the step that failed ('chip id', 'read'), null when it passed

rate.note: the gyro in degrees per second: plan B's to_float of its floored centidegree integer; the port's exact 2000/32768 dps a count lies within the floor's 0.01

divergence.note: the port routes data-ready to INT1 again and clears it, as setup did: plan B re-armed the sensors only, so INT1 stayed unrouted and the driver fell back to polling
the port reports a gyro that never leaves start-up after the re-arm; plan B dropped the verdict

rearm.note: rearm() after a healthy setup (its transcript in `setup`): the re-arm transcript and ok (plan B logs a failure); a case with a divergence owes its script and ok instead

setup.note: setup() over a scripted part: input whether INT1 is wired and the transcript; output ok

wake.note: run() with wait() answering the scripted irq_runs: after each wake, whether the INT line is called silent (null with no wire) and whether the note fired (once, at 20 timed-out wakes)
